fullPassage: Young children write with all their attention focused on each letter. Despite this, it's common for them to write some of the letters backwards. This is called "mirror writing," and it may be caused by the way our brains store images, known as "mirror generalization." When we remember images, we focus on shape rather than orientation. This is because early humans needed to be able to recognize a dangerous predator, such as a tiger, from any angle. Therefore, whether we're looking at a tiger directly or from the side, we still immediately know it's a tiger. It is believed that mirror generalization, combined with a child's weak understanding of right and left, is what causes the occasional backward letter.

questions.passage: When we remember images, we focus on shape rather than orientation. It is believed that mirror generalization, __________ (combine) with a child's weak understanding of right and left, is what causes the occasional backward letter.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: combine(결합하다) → combined (과거분사). A, combined with B = A가 B와 결합되어 (수동 분사구문)
det.analysis: combine을 combined로 바꿔요. 'mirror generalization, combined with ~'은 '거울상 일반화가 ~와 결합되어'라는 뜻이에요. 주어가 '결합되는' 대상이므로 과거분사 combined를 쓰는 수동 분사구문이에요.
det.tip: 명사, combined with ~ = ~와 결합되어 (과거분사 분사구문)

questions.passage: Young children write with all their attention focused on each letter. Despite this, it's common for them to write some of the letters backwards. This is called "mirror writing," and it may be caused by the way our brains store images, known as "mirror generalization." When we remember images, we __________ rather than orientation. This is because early humans needed to be able to recognize a dangerous predator, such as a tiger, from any angle. Therefore, whether we're looking at a tiger directly or from the side, we still immediately know it's a tiger. It is believed that mirror generalization, combined with a child's weak understanding of right and left, is what causes the occasional backward letter.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ignore the color=색을 무시하다 / change the size=크기를 바꾸다 / focus on shape=형태에 집중하다 / forget the name=이름을 잊다
det.analysis:
① ignore the color: 색을 무시? 뒤의 'rather than orientation(방향보다)'과 대비 안 됨
② change the size: 크기를 바꿈? 문맥 무관
③ focus on shape: 이미지를 기억할 때 방향보다 '형태에 집중' ←정답
④ forget the name: 이름을 잊음? 문맥 무관
det.tip: ___ rather than orientation(방향보다) → 대비되는 focus on shape(형태에 집중)

questions.passage: Young children write with all their attention focused on each letter. Despite this, it's common for them to write some of the letters backwards. This is called "mirror writing," and it may be caused by the way our brains __________, known as "mirror generalization." When we remember images, we focus on shape rather than orientation. This is because early humans needed to be able to recognize a dangerous predator, such as a tiger, from any angle. Therefore, whether we're looking at a tiger directly or from the side, we still immediately know it's a tiger. It is believed that mirror generalization, combined with a child's weak understanding of right and left, is what causes the occasional backward letter.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: lose focus=집중력을 잃다 / store images=이미지를 저장하다 / feel afraid=두려워하다 / move quickly=빠르게 움직이다
det.analysis:
① lose focus: 집중력을 잃음? '거울상 일반화'라는 저장 방식과 무관
② store images: 뇌가 이미지를 '저장하는' 방식 = 거울상 일반화 ←정답
③ feel afraid: 두려워함? 문맥 무관
④ move quickly: 빠르게 움직임? 문맥 무관
det.tip: the way our brains ___, known as mirror generalization → store images(이미지 저장)
